title: Function tenant context, batch 3: proposal-actions, knowledge-query, monitoring-view, automation-view, image-service, announcements, reference-word-index, renditions
description: Move these handlers to the TenantContext. Remove each from PENDING in scripts/test-function-tenant-context.ts. Spec: features_backend/function-tenant-context.feature.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Needs decisions before code: proposal-actions writes the Proposal table through boto3 and scans it for story drafts (no tenant index on Proposal); monitoring-view, automation-view, knowledge-query (S3 Vectors search, the knowledge-search surface) and image-service call modules whose stores read PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID or no tenant; renditions and reference-word-index are triggered by S3 and stream events, not AppSync, so they take the tenant from the key or the record, which is the invocation context (build_invocation_tenant_context).
